text:
maria-partners: QBR prep check-in — we need: updated partner scorecards, an MDF reallocation proposal across marketplace / SI / HW, and a joint-announcement timeline for the Acme SI integration. Target: finalize by Friday EOD. Who can own each piece?

kevin-sales: I can own the marketplace scorecard update. Need ARR by partner and active pipeline. @lina-finance can you confirm current MDF balance and any hard constraints? :thumbsup:

lina-finance: MDF pool remaining = $420,000. Constraints: up to $150k reserved for enterprise co-sell commitments, 30% max to any single partner without exec approval. My suggested split: marketplace 40% (168k), SI integrations 35% (147k), HW credits 25% (105k). I'll drop a sheet in the doc.

ajay-hw: For HW co-funding — pinged Nvidia and CoreCompute this morning. Nvidia contact (sarah@nvidia) said they'd consider up to 50% on qualified pilots, still needs commercial sign-off. CoreCompute asked for a joint ROI slide; I'll loop in product for numbers.

maria-partners: good. kevin — when you update scorecards, please include: MRR, churn, enablement level (1-3), and marketplace listing status. Short template: Partner | MRR | Churn% | Enablement | Listing (yes/no) | Action

kevin-sales: Got it. I'll use the template. Quick formula for the listing completeness score I use: `=ROUND( (COUNTA(B2:E2)/4)*100, 0 )` — returns percent of required fields filled.

taylor-ops: On the joint-announcement timeline for Acme SI integration, proposed dates: internal dry run Tues 9am, press/partner comms Thu 10am, partner portal listing Fri noon. We need a one-pager + co-branded banner and a partner-facing runbook for SI onboarding. I can draft the runbook.

maria-partners: timeline works. Owners: marketplace scorecards = @kevin-sales, MDF allocation proposal + numbers = @lina-finance, HW co-fund confirmations = @ajay-hw, announcement playbook + runbook = @taylor-ops. I'll compile final doc.

kevin-sales: Quick Q — for the marketplace listing push, do we want to prioritize partners with Marketplace-ready apps (status = yes) or those with highest short-term pipeline? My instinct: prioritize pipeline for QBR motion.

maria-partners: prioritize pipeline for QBR (we need bookings lift this quarter). But keep a small set (top 5) marketplace-ready partners in the announcement to show ecosystem breadth.

lina-finance: Note on approval flow: any single partner MDF > $100k needs GTM lead + finance approval; > $200k requires CRO sign-off. I'll mark those thresholds on the sheet.

ajay-hw: Nvidia may push for a joint case study before committing funds. Recommend we offer a co-funded pilot + logo use case. I'll start an email thread.

kevin-sales: I'll prepare 1-slide partner scorecard summary for the QBR deck — top 6 partners, allocation ask, and KPI targets. ETA: Wed EOD.

taylor-ops: Putting the announcement checklist here: 1) One-pager copy (maria) 2) Partner quote (kevin) 3) Banner + assets (design) 4) Portal update (eng) 5) Customer comms draft (growth) 6) MDF allocation note (lina). I'll create a kanban card and assign.

maria-partners: perfect. small ask: can everyone drop their artifacts into the shared folder `Partners/QBR_Acme_Integration` by Thu 5pm? link: https://drive.redwood/Partners/QBR_Acme_Integration

calendar-bot: Event added — "QBR: Partner Ops Review" on 3059991200 (Thu 16:00) — attendees: maria-partners, kevin-sales, taylor-ops, lina-finance, ajay-hw.

kevin-sales: noted, will upload scorecards by Wed morning.

lina-finance: I'll add the allocation table and a small sensitivity sheet showing 3 scenarios (conservative / base / aggressive).

ajay-hw: I'll follow up with HW partners and update by Thu 12pm.

maria-partners: thanks all — will assemble and circulate final proposal for sign-off on Thu 6pm. :rocket:
